cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 46% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.36% · WTI +0.16% · Brent +0.40% · NatGas -0.31%. 46% of 67 energy names are green — a mixed, rotational tape. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +6.46%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.46%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.88%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +22.11%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +22.11%, BE +9.05%, ENPH +8.92%, SEDG +8.86%, EOSE +7.95%. Laggards: FANG -3.70%, MPLX -2.44%, PR -2.28%, APA -2.15%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ARRY moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ARRY is +22.11% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
